attr.title: Stepping Stones
attr.desc: Watch a safe path light up across a floor of tiles, then walk it from memory - one wrong step and the tile breaks! 150 levels over easy, medium and hard, stars and badges to collect, and big, kid-friendly text with button pictures. An original memory game made for kids (and grown-ups).
attr.inst: Ready to run out of the box, no additional files needed.
